scanner.explanations.collectsData: Dokar NDP ta shafi duk wani sarrafa bayanan sirri na 'yan Najeriya.
scanner.explanations.sensitiveData: Sashe na 30 yana buƙatar kariya ta musamman ga bayanan sirri masu mahimmanci ciki har da bayanan lafiya da bayometrik.
scanner.explanations.hasPrivacyPolicy: Sashe na 27 yana buƙatar manufar sirri mai gaskiya da sauƙin isa.
scanner.explanations.crossBorderTransfer: Sassan 41-43 suna hana canja wurin bayanai zuwa ƙasashen da basu da isasshen matakan kariya.
scanner.explanations.hasConsentMechanism: Sashe na 26 yana buƙatar izini na musamman, bayyananne, da kuma maras shakka.
scanner.explanations.targetsChildren: Sashe na 31 yana buƙatar tabbatar da shekaru da izinin iyaye ga masu amfani da basu kai shekara 18 ba.
scanner.explanations.thirdPartySharing: Sashe na 25 yana buƙatar yarjejeniyar sarrafa bayanai tare da masu sarrafa ɓangare na uku.
scanner.explanations.hasBreachProcess: Sashe na 40 yana buƙatar bayar da rahoton ɓoyewar bayanai cikin awa 72 ga NDPC.
scanner.explanations.registeredWithNDPC: Sashe na 44 yana buƙatar rajista a matsayin mai sarrafa bayanai mai mahimmanci.
scanner.explanations.usesAI: GAID 2025 Mataki na 15 yana buƙatar bayyana gaskiya don tsarin yanke shawara ta atomatik.

scanner.explanation.low: "{{appName}}" yana da ƙaramin hadarin bin doka a ƙarƙashin {{framework}}. Kariya ta asali tana nan. Ci gaba da lura da ayyukan bayananka.
scanner.explanation.medium: "{{appName}}" yana da matsakaicin hadarin bin doka a ƙarƙashin {{framework}}. Wurare da yawa suna buƙatar kulawa don guje wa yiwuwar matakin tilastawa.
scanner.explanation.high: "{{appName}}" yana da manyan hadarurrukan bin doka a ƙarƙashin {{framework}}. Idan ba a gyara ba, za ka iya fuskantar hukuncin doka.
scanner.explanation.critical: "{{appName}}" yana cikin babban hadari a ƙarƙashin {{framework}}! Ana buƙatar matakin gaggawa don guje wa hukunci mai tsanani.

problem.title.part1: Yawancin Masu Farawa a Najeriya Suna Gano
problem.story.part1: Wani mai ƙirƙira a Najeriya ya ƙaddamar da manhajar lafiya.
problem.story.part2: Masu amfani suna son ta — 5,000 sun yi rajista a mako na farko. Bayan makonni biyu, NDPC ta aika da sanarwar tilastawa.
problem.fine.part2: — ko 2% na kudaden shiga na shekara, wanda ya fi girma. Babu manufar sirri. Babu tsarin yarda. Babu binciken bayanai.
problem.solution: RegTrack na hana wannan. Cikin mintuna, ba watanni ba.
solution.subtitle: RegTrack yana ba ku damar fahimtar bin doka nan take ta hanyar cikakken tsarin NDP Act da GAID 2025.

checklist.items.rem-dpia.title: Gudanar da Kimanta Tasirin Kare Bayanai

footer.tagline: Haɗa ƙirƙira da ƙa'idojin Najeriya. Bin NDP Act & GAID 2025 ta AI ga masu gina makomar Afirka.
footer.whyBuilt.title: Me Ya Sa Muka Gina Wannan don Najeriya
footer.whyBuilt.description: An gina shi a Abuja daga masu ƙirƙira 'yan Najeriya, don ƙa'idojin Najeriya. Mun yi imani kowane mai farawa a Najeriya ya cancanci ƙaddamarwa da tabbaci — sanin cewa ayyukan bayanansu suna kare masu amfani da kasuwancinsu. RegTrack ta wanzu saboda bin ƙa'ida bai kamata ya zama shamaki ga ƙirƙira a cikin mafi girman yanayin fasaha na Afirka ba. Ana amfani da NDP Act 2023, Tsarin Aiwatar da NDPR, da GAID 2025.
